boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named University of Evansville destinations for studying, gathering, art, reflection, recreation, and campus events.

cards.title: Bower-Suhrheinrich Library
cards.subtitle: Library study rooms and collaborative spaces
cards.notes: Book a group study room before bringing a project team; library materials are on upper floors, and the library supports research and collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: A campus library building with group rooms, research services, and collaborative study space.
cards.evidence_claim: UE Libraries reports 16 group study rooms and collaborative spaces, with book collections in Bower-Suhrheinrich Library.
cards.source_title: Facts, Collections, and Mission — University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current-hours page and reserve a room through its booking link.

cards.title: Clifford Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Library collections and media-study rooms
cards.notes: Use the second-floor group study rooms when a media assignment calls for viewing library DVDs or CDs with classmates; ask at the Information Desk for discs.
cards.short_summary: A connected library building with media holdings and group viewing rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UE Libraries states that DVDs and CDs are housed on the second floor and that group study rooms are available there for viewing media materials.
cards.source_title: Facts, Collections, and Mission — University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Bring the desired media title to the Information Desk; staff retrieve the corresponding disc.

cards.title: Ridgway University Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub with lounges, recreation, dining, and services
cards.notes: Use this central building as a practical meetup point, then check the day’s campus calendar for events in its halls, lounges, and second-floor spaces.
cards.short_summary: A 90,000-square-foot campus center combining dining, lounges, recreation, and event space.
cards.evidence_claim: UE describes Ridgway University Center as a 90,000-square-foot facility with dining facilities, a 500-seat auditorium, lounges, recreational areas, and the bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Building services and individual venues may keep different hours; consult the relevant UE office or event listing.

cards.title: Eykamp Hall
cards.subtitle: Ridgway University Center event hall
cards.notes: Check UE event listings for talks, showcases, and organized activities scheduled in this hall; arrive through Ridgway University Center and follow event signage.
cards.short_summary: A named campus event hall within Ridgway University Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UE’s 2026 Road Trip schedule places a dinner, welcome session, and Road Trip Rodeo activities in Eykamp Hall at Ridgway University Center.
cards.source_title: Road Trip 2026 Schedule — University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: Access depends on the scheduled event; verify the event listing before visiting.

cards.title: Neu Chapel
cards.subtitle: Chapel, prayer room, gallery, and campus-event venue
cards.notes: Visit respectfully for a concert, lecture, forum, ceremony, or quiet reflection; the building also contains an interfaith prayer room and Wesley Gallery.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel used for spiritual life and a range of public-facing campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: UE states that Neu Chapel houses an inter-faith 24-hour prayer room and hosts worship services, concerts, lectures, community forums, and campus ceremonies.
cards.source_title: History of Neu Chapel — University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: Respect worship and ceremony use; event and gallery access can vary.

cards.title: Aces Haven
cards.subtitle: Student-created food pantry in Neu Chapel, Room 100
cards.notes: If you need food support, enter Neu Chapel’s east door facing Memorial Plaza and Bower-Suhrheinrich Library, then look straight ahead for Room 100.
cards.short_summary: A Student Government Association-managed pantry created by students to address food insecurity.
cards.evidence_claim: UE says Aces Haven was created by students for students, is in Neu Chapel Room 100, and is managed by the Student Government Association.
cards.access_notes: Typically open when Neu Chapel is open, about 7 a.m.–11 p.m., except during breaks; confirm conditions on arrival.

cards.title: Melvin Peterson Gallery
cards.subtitle: 1935 Lincoln Avenue art exhibition space
cards.notes: Check the current exhibit before heading over, then use the listed gallery hours or contact the Art Department to confirm access for your visit.
cards.short_summary: A University of Evansville gallery presenting changing work by local and regional artists, alumni, and students.
cards.evidence_claim: UE identifies Melvin Peterson Gallery at 1935 Lincoln Avenue as an exhibit space with changing artwork by local and regional artists, alumni, and students.
cards.access_notes: When the University is in session: noon–3 p.m. Monday, Tuesday, Friday, Saturday; noon–6 p.m. Wednesday and Thursday, or by appointment.

cards.title: Krannert Gallery
cards.subtitle: Krannert Hall of Art and Music lobby gallery
cards.notes: Pair a walk through the Krannert Hall lobby with the current student or professional-art exhibition; contact the Art Department if you need gallery-access details.
cards.short_summary: A lobby gallery where student and professional artists’ changing exhibitions are shown.
cards.evidence_claim: UE says Krannert Gallery, in the lobby of Krannert Hall of Art and Music, features changing exhibits by students and professional artists.
cards.access_notes: When the University is in session: Monday–Saturday 8 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sunday noon–11 p.m. Confirm exhibit access with Art.

cards.title: Carson Center
cards.subtitle: Campus athletics and fitness destination
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate Carson Center, then check the relevant Athletics or fitness program for event, facility, and participant access information.
cards.short_summary: A named University of Evansville athletics destination on the official campus map.
cards.evidence_claim: The University of Evansville’s official campus map lists Carson Center among athletics destinations.
cards.access_notes: Athletic events and fitness facilities have separate schedules and access rules; confirm before visiting.

cards.title: Esports Center
cards.subtitle: Schroeder Residence Hall esports venue
cards.notes: Look for a scheduled esports match or campus program, and confirm the event’s location and spectator details before heading to Schroeder Residence Hall.
cards.short_summary: A named campus esports destination listed on UE’s map and used for organized competition.
cards.evidence_claim: UE’s campus map lists the Esports Center, and its 2026 Road Trip schedule places an Overwatch competition there in Schroeder Residence Hall.
cards.source_title: Road Trip 2026 Schedule — University of Evansville
cards.access_notes: Access and spectator availability depend on the scheduled program; verify with UE Esports or the event listing.
